title: Infinite Milk
body: This mod adds a simple keybind functionality that allows players to instantly give themselves a bucket of milk when pressed. Designed for convenience, this mod streamlines the process of obtaining milk without having to manually find a cow and use a bucket. Whether you're in the middle of an adventure or need to quickly remove negative status effects, this mod provides a seamless way to get a bucket of milk with just a single keypress. Simply configure the keybind in the settings, and enjoy the ease of milk on demand!
